content_zh:
大楚，十里镇，季秋。
镇里第一高手，死了
巡检司府衙大堂上，摆着一具尸体。
尸体旁坐了个书生打扮的年轻人。
堂上堂下，围着父老乡亲。
“姓名？”案桌前的巡检问道。
“陆天明。”年轻男子冷静回答。
“年龄？”
“二十。”
“做什么的？”
“该溜子。”
“什么？”
“无业。”
“那就是地痞无赖？”
“我不欺负人。”
说到这，陆天明轻轻咳嗽起来。
咳得面色发白，想来是有肺疾。
巡检周世豪眯了眯眼：“陆天明，你发现张平尸体的时候，附近有没有其他人，特别是，一个女人？”
“没有，当时已是傍晚，我也是被尸体绊倒才发现的。”
陆天明掏出手绢，擦拭嘴角。

手绢上顿时有一片红色氤氲开来。
“你这咳嗽，确定不是因为跟人打斗造成的？”周世豪没有丝毫同情。
陆天明抬头瞥一眼案桌后十里镇的土皇帝：“五岁时掉河里落下的病根，大人不信，可向街坊邻居求证。”
“那你衣服上的血迹，是怎么回事？不要告诉我是咳出来的血。”
啪——！
说完，周世豪一拍惊堂木，吓了围观百姓一大跳。
陆天明却没受丝毫影响，回答仍然井井有条。
“昨天我帮人收债，路过王婶家，她家杀猪，我帮忙按猪，衣服上粘的，是猪血。”
“收债？你刚才不是说，你无业吗？”周世豪冷哼道。
“收债，上不得台面，不算正当活计。”陆天明答道。
周世豪蹙了蹙眉，转头看向人群。
“王婶，有这事？”
有一妇人战战兢兢从人群中走出来：“是的周大人，昨天接近傍晚的时候，陆秀才确实是帮我家杀猪来着。”
妇人退下，周世豪继续问道：“事发地在黄土巷，离巡检司府衙不过小半柱香的路程，你刚才说在傍晚发现的尸体，为什么天黑透才来报官？”
陆天明眼中飘过一丝怒色，却没做回答。
周世豪旁边的副巡检于勇，主动回道：“周兄，天明的脚，不利索。”
闻言，周世豪打量陆天明双腿。
content_en:
Da Chu, Shili Town, Ji Qiu.
The top master in town is dead
There was a corpse placed in the lobby of the Inspection Department's office.
Next to the body sat a young man dressed as a scholar.
People in the hall were surrounded by fellow villagers.
"Name?" the inspector at the desk asked.
"Lu Tianming." The young man replied calmly.
"Age?"
"Twenty."
"What to do?"
"It's time to sneak away."
"What?"
"No job."
"Is that a rogue?"
"I don't bully people."
Speaking of this, Lu Tianming coughed slightly.
He coughed so hard that his face turned pale, so he thought he had lung disease.
Inspector Zhou Shihao narrowed his eyes: "Lu Tianming, when you found Zhang Ping's body, was there anyone else nearby, especially a woman?"
"No, it was already evening, and I only discovered it when I tripped over the body."
Lu Tianming took out his handkerchief and wiped the corners of his mouth.
Suddenly there was a patch of red mist on the handkerchief.
"Are you sure your cough wasn't caused by fighting with someone?" Zhou Shihao didn't have the slightest sympathy.
Lu Tianming raised his head and glanced at the local emperor from Shili Town behind the desk: "If you don't believe that the disease fell into the river when I was five years old, you can ask your neighbors for confirmation."
"Then what's the blood stain on your clothes? Don't tell me it's the blood you coughed up."
Snap——!
After saying that, Zhou Shihao slapped the crowd with surprise, startling the onlookers.
Lu Tianming was not affected at all, and his answers were still in order.
"Yesterday I was helping someone collect debts and passed by Aunt Wang's house. Her family was killing pigs. I helped press the pigs. The blood on my clothes was pig blood."
"Debt collection? Didn't you just say that you were unemployed?" Zhou Shihao snorted coldly.
"Debt collection is not a legitimate job." Lu Tianming replied.
Zhou Shihao frowned and turned to look at the crowd.
"Aunt Wang, is this happening?"
A woman walked out of the crowd tremblingly: "Yes, Mr. Zhou, yesterday towards evening, Lu Xiucai was indeed helping my family kill pigs."
The woman stepped back, and Zhou Shihao continued to ask: "The incident happened in Huangtu Lane, which is only half a stick of incense away from the inspection office. You just said that you found the body in the evening. Why did you come to report to the official after it was dark?"
There was a hint of anger in Lu Tianming's eyes, but he didn't answer.
Deputy Inspector Yu Yong next to Zhou Shihao took the initiative to reply: "Brother Zhou, Tianming's feet are not in good condition."
Hearing this, Zhou Shihao looked at Lu Tianming's legs.
